# CCOS Research Lab repository agent instructions

Before repository changes, fetch and read the persistent off-main research/ecosystem roadmap:

```bash
git fetch origin agent/ecosystem-roadmap && \
git show origin/agent/ecosystem-roadmap:.agent/CCOS_RESEARCH_LAB_ECOSYSTEM_ROADMAP.yaml
```

Treat root `AGENTS.md` as mandatory bootstrap policy. If the roadmap is unavailable, fail closed for major vendored-semantic, generated-code-isolation, product-promotion, cross-repository, or merge decisions.

Keep Research Lab experimental, preserve owner-repository lineage for embedded engines, and never promote research mechanisms into Core or Enterprise without their separate qualification gates.
